These filters work well with my Ekobrew Elite stainless steel cup. The paper material is thinner than some of the other filters I've tried, which allows the water to flow faster. I found that by pushing the filter to the bottom of the cup and filling with coffee about 3/4 full, it makes a good cup of coffee. If the filter isn't pushed to the cup bottom, the paper can blow out, releasing the grounds into the cup. Some of the other filters I've tried are too thick, restricting water flow, which occasionally caused the coffee maker pump to strain and not shut down properly. The type of coffee used is important as some grinds are too fine or too coarse, which can affect the water flow. It took a bit of experimentation, but this filter with my coffee, works well for me.
